title: Windowed pagination
description: Keep the active page centered as a long page list advances.
useCase: Keep the active page centered as a long page list advances.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Twenty local page states with a sliding visible window. No content is fetched.
look: Cool light-grey background, a white document sheet with skeleton lines and a tilted pale-blue numbered tile, above a white rounded bar of page numbers.
motion: Changing page slides the number strip sideways over 250 ms ease-out, keeping the current page centred until the ends; the preview tile re-tilts a few degrees in 230 ms.
adapt: The strip offset is the inline `translateX` on `page-numbers`, computed from `start` (a five-slot window, 32 px per button) with a 250 ms CSS transition; `page-art` rotation is decorative. Replace the hard-coded 20-page total (also the 640 px strip width) and the `page-sheet` mock.
